title: Control: divide each muscle by the largest value it reached in session 1 (one single sample, at 1 kHz).
hypothesis: Reference for the other three arms. Same scaling as the baseline and D01 without auto-gain.
motivation: Fixed settings for the whole normalization study: total torque (no passive subtraction), balanced positions (each position's target divided by its standard deviation), clean passive table not used (nothing is subtracted), 0.2 s window, no auto-gain, LSTM 8x2, original training settings, learn session 1 -> predict session 2.
